strings.privacy:metadata: The Cohorts factor plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.settings:cohort_help: Select the cohorts that will not pass this factor. This allows you to force these cohorts to use other factors to authenticate.
strings.settings:description:
Select the user cohorts that must use additional factors to authenticate. If this factor is not set up, all cohorts will be required to use additional factors by default.

This factor requires a cohort to be created.
strings.settings:shortdescription: Specify which cohorts of users must use other factors to authenticate. Must be combined with other factors.
strings.summarycondition: does NOT have any of the following cohorts assigned in any context: {$a}
